name: Tipranavir

own_problems.text: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for liver harm and nerve and brain harm

examples.title: Effect of Cytoreductive Chemotherapy and a CCR5 Coreceptor Antagonist on HIV-1 Eradication
Quality of Life of HIV-infected Participants Switched to Raltegravir Versus Other Antiretroviral Regimens (MK-0518-266)
examples.why: The trial was terminated early due to slow recruitment.

summary: In the United States, Tipranavir has a boxed warning, which is the strongest alert on a medicine label, for damage to the liver and harm to the nervous system. [3] A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave the drug a medium-level score of 65 for liver concerns and a medium-level score of 55 for heart concerns. [M] Additionally, two research trials involving the drug were stopped early, one because it failed to meet expected benefit goals and another due to slow enrollment of volunteers. [5][6]
